confidence_notes: Food anchors use recent aggregated Athens cost-of-living prices. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain; they are estimated at about twice and 1.2 times the local draft-beer price, respectively. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for July high season; no live lodging listings were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Athens-specific food and drink prices anchor those estimates. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of a high-tourism Southern European capital in July.
